item.title: Communicable disease threats report, 12-18 September, week 38
item.description: This issue of the ECDC Communicable Disease Threats Report (CDTR) covers the period 12-18 September, and includes updates on Ebola, malaria, botulism, avian influenza A(H9N2), influenza A(H5), West Nile virus infections, chikungunya, dengue, Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever, Vibrio, measles.

item.title: Communicable disease threats report, 22 - 28 August, week 35
item.description: This issue includes updates on diphtheria, Ebola, swine influenza A(H1N2), Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever, dengue, chikungunya virus disease, West Nile virus, cholera, poliovirus and expert deployments.
